added.description:

Values Value is a recruiting company with expertise in game development and is currently looking for a Chief Product Officer
for the gamedev business unit of a global ad-tech group. Founded in 2018, the unit has grown to roughly 35 people across Barcelona, Warsaw and Florida (plus a few remote team members), and benefits from being part of a larger ad-tech company with its own ad network, proprietary data and personalized monetization infrastructure.

The unit builds and scales a portfolio of casual evergreen mobile games – cards, puzzle and word and is systematically expanding into adjacent scalable genres. We're looking for someone to own the product function end-to-end: a hands-on leader who owns both product strategy and development-leadership mandate, and who is accountable for turning hit generation into a repeatable system.

What are you working on?

Genres: Puzzle, Casual, Word Games

For which tasks (responsibilities)?

Own the product function end-to-end – from portfolio strategy to day-to-day execution.
Set, defend and evolve strategy across the in-house portfolio together with the unit's leadership: decide what to double down on, what to sunset, and what to greenlight next
Manage and hands-on coach product owners (5 direct reports): challenge roadmaps together
Get personally into the data and the hypotheses – analyze metrics, review and test prototypes yourself, including light vibe-coding of simple tests when useful
Build a structured hypothesis pipeline with clear prototyping standards, balancing quality and throughput
Coordinate with adjacent functions – monetization, marketing, data – run as separate departments within the unit
Take on strategic oversight of the external partner studio as part of full portfolio ownership over time
Champion practical AI adoption across the team – no-code / vibe-coding tools that let even non-engineers build automations and speed up daily product work
Hire, develop and retain the product team as it grows
Report on product status and results to the unit's leadership and, for major investment decisions, to the parent company's board

What kind of professional are we looking for?

Proven track record as Head of Product / CPO / Product Lead in mobile evergreen games.
Deep understanding of ad-monetization economics: eCPM, ARPU/ARPDAU, retention curves, LTV, mediation/waterfall
Genuinely hands-on with data – comfortable digging into the numbers yourself
Experience combining product and development leadership: understands dev processes, release cycles and prototyping well enough to run both without a separate Head of Development
AI literacy: practical, personal use of AI / no-code / vibe-coding tools to build automations and prototypes
Upper-Intermediate English or higher
An entrepreneurial streak – own-project or founder experience is a plus

What is important for us in a person?

Hands-on – ready to dig into data and test prototypes personally
Ownership & accountability – takes full responsibility for outcomes, from strategy to execution
Ability to challenge – comfortable pushing back on strategy and roadmaps with both leadership and product owners
Coaching and clarity – develops product owners, builds trust, explains not just what to do but why
Pragmatism under uncertainty – accepts that no hit is guaranteed and treats growth as a disciplined process of testing hypotheses
Direct, honest communication – speaks from facts, avoids unnecessary politics
Lean-startup mindset – fast iteration, resourcefulness, comfortable with experimentation
Growth-ready – open to taking on a broader strategic mandate as trust with leadership builds

Why do we enjoy working here?

Real ownership of the product function, with the mandate to challenge and reshape strategy
Part of a larger ad-tech group – access to a proprietary ad network, data and personalized monetization infrastructure as a built-in edge
A small, senior, high-ownership team
A well-considered system for professional growth and regular, honest feedback
Transparent management and the ability to propose plans and strategy changes and see them approved and executed
A culture built around data-driven decisions, ownership, continuous improvement and a lean-startup mentality

What are the conditions and bonuses?

Office-based role in Barcelona (open-space, kitchen with cooked lunches, parking, gym in the building, terrace, game room)
8-hour working day with flexible core hours
Full-time staff position, fully official employment
Relocation to Barcelona, with a relocation package for the candidate and family
Medical insurance, meals and beverages at the office, gym and language courses
Paid vacation and sick leave
6-month probation period

The selection process

Screening with the Values Value recruiter
Interview with the General Manager of the Gaming unit
Interview with a board member / co-founder
Test task (optional)
Offer

added.title: Senior Manager, Audience & Product Analytics, NYT Wirecutter
added.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates in the independent journalism and media industry, focusing on delivering reliable news and information to a global audience. It addresses the challenge of providing trustworthy journalism by maintaining a world-renowned newsroom with correspondents reporting from nearly 160 countries. The organization prioritizes high-quality journalism across multiple platforms, including print, audio, digital, and apps, with a business strategy centered on producing journalism that audiences find valuable enough to support financially.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR MANAGER, AUDIENCE & PRODUCT ANALYTICS is responsible for leading a team to deepen the understanding of audience behavior and engagement with content and product features. This role drives the growth strategy by providing data-driven insights that inform product improvements and optimize user engagement. The position collaborates with audience, product, and engineering leaders to set goals, design experiments, and identify opportunities that enhance the organization's reach and impact.

Responsibilities:

Manage a team of three analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity and excellence.
Analyze audience growth, traffic drivers, user engagement, and customer journey touchpoints.
Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and editorial teams to define strategy and build analytics roadmaps.
Lead design, execution, and analysis of product experiments such as A/B testing.
Translate complex data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
Support and uphold the value of journalistic independence and the mission to provide truthful, informative content.

Requirements:

6+ years in data analytics, with experience supporting product or publishing teams.
2+ years of people management experience leading analysts.
5+ years of experience with A/B testing.
1+ years reporting on audience engagement, traffic trends, or customer journey modeling in digital publishing or media.
Advanced SQL skills and experience with BI/data visualization tools like Tableau or Looker.

Preferred qualifications include proficiency in Python or R, knowledge of digital media or affiliate marketing, and a quantitative degree in relevant fields.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The annual base pay range for this role is between $140,000 and $160,000 USD.
Eligibility for variable pay such as annual bonuses and restricted stock may apply.

Benefits & Perks:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Flexible Spending Accounts.
Company-matching 401(k) plan.
Employee stock purchase plan.
Paid vacation, sick days, and parental leave.
Tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

added.title: Sr Product Manager - MP&A Platforms
added.description:
Our Story

J.Crew gets you dressed every day, for every occasion.

Since 1983, we’ve been creating classics that feel familiar and refreshingly new, crafted with unbeatable quality and distinctive point of view—it’s no wonder we’ve been in your closet for four decades and counting.

Today, we continue to do the classics our way, inspiring not only how you shop but how you define your personal style. Our commitment runs deeper than just making great clothes—we’re proud of our role in getting you dressed with confidence, character, and celebrating a distinctly American sensibility that makes us who we are.

Our dedication to Diversity, Equity, Belonging & Sustainability has been celebrated with industry recognition, reflecting our commitment to fostering an inclusive and sustainable workplace.

Job Summary

J.Crew is seeking a Senior Product Owner – MP&A, Merchandising Analytics & AI Platforms to lead the evolution of the systems supporting Merchandising, Merchandise Planning, Store Planning, Allocation, and Merchandising Analytics capabilities.

This role serves as the product and subject matter authority for enterprise planning, allocation, merchandising analytics, and emerging AI-enabled platforms. The Senior Product Owner will drive product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, and continuous improvement initiatives that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Working closely with business leaders, engineering teams, vendors, and analytics partners, this role will guide cross-functional discussions, prioritize enhancements based on business value, and help shape the future of merchandising and planning technology at J.Crew.

The ideal candidate combines strong product leadership, retail domain expertise, technical fluency, and a hands-on approach to solving complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Own and manage the product roadmap for merchandising, planning, allocation, and analytics platforms.
Define and prioritize product backlogs, enhancements, defect resolution, and strategic initiatives.
Translate complex business requirements into actionable product specifications and user stories.
Lead platform evolution efforts across systems including o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, legacy assortment tools, and emerging AI-enabled technologies.
Partner with internal engineering teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
Drive initiatives that improve analytics adoption, data trust, workflow efficiency, and operational decision-making.
Evaluate and support AI-enabled technologies that enhance merchandising and planning capabilities.
Facilitate alignment across Merchandising, Merchandise Planning, Store Planning, Allocation, Analytics, and Technology teams.
Mentor and lead a small product and analytics team, supporting prioritization, development, and collaboration.
Support vendor relationships, delivery governance, and strategic platform investment decisions.

Qualifications

7–10+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, or enterprise application leadership roles.
Experience supporting retail merchandising, planning, allocation, or analytics platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS product management and roadmap leadership.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in complex business environments.
Experience translating business needs into scalable technology solutions.
Familiarity with planning platforms such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, or similar technologies preferred.
Exposure to analytics, AI-enabled technologies, or data-driven product environments.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
Experience working in agile or product-led development environments preferred.

Why Join Us

At J.Crew, you’ll help shape the future of merchandising and planning technology while leading initiatives that directly influence how teams make strategic business decisions. This role provides the opportunity to drive meaningful transformation through analytics, platform modernization, and emerging AI capabilities within a highly collaborative retail environment.

We welcome you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes. Our passion is scouting life-long learners who are driven by curiosity, and who feel connected to our brands and share our desire to make an impact. We’re always seeking bright new talent who leverage their unique experiences to discover, grow and evolve with our teams.

Benefits + Perks

Health & Well-being - Eligible associates and family members receive medical, dental, prescription and vision insurance, family planning (fertility, adoption & surrogacy support), fitness discounts, medical travel and more.
Associate Discount - We love our products just as much as you do! That’s why we offer a great associate discount across all of our brands (J.Crew, J.Crew Factory, and Madewell).
Summer Fridays - In addition to our hybrid work model, we also close our office at 1:00 PM every Friday during the Summer months.
Community Impact - We support the communities where we live and work through our philanthropic efforts and the J.Crew Cares Program.
Winter Break - In addition to our PTO package, J.Crew Group offers a winter break at the end of December to eligible full-time associates at the Home Office to provide time to refresh and recharge.

Note: Availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to work location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements.

Salary Range: $136,000.00 - $175,500.00

At J.Crew Group (JCG) we aim to pay competitively for our company’s size and industry. The base salary offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region of work premises, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base salary is just one component of J.Crew Group’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes the opportunity for bonus, competitive benefits and perks.

One of our core focuses here at JCG is creating a community and culture that builds belonging. We are deeply committed to our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion efforts, and we warmly welcome job applicants of all backgrounds.

JCG is proud to affirmatively provide equal opportunity to all associates and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin or citizenship, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, legally protected physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected under applicable law.

added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
Company Description
GİZLİ is a forward-looking organization focused on building innovative products that deliver measurable value to customers and stakeholders. The company fosters a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, encouraging team members to experiment, learn, and iterate quickly. Decisions are driven by data, customer insights, and a strong emphasis on product quality and usability. Team members work in an environment that supports flexibility, remote collaboration, and professional growth opportunities. Joining GİZLİ offers the chance to shape impactful products while contributing to a high-performance, inclusive workplace.
Role Description
The Senior Product Manager will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and definition to launch and optimization, in a full-time remote capacity. This role will gather and analyze customer feedback, market research, and usage data to define product vision, strategy, and measurable objectives. The Senior Product Manager will create and maintain product roadmaps, write clear requirements and user stories, and prioritize the backlog in alignment with business goals. They will collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features, and will coordinate product launches, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Ongoing responsibilities include monitoring product performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and driving experiments to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
Qualifications

Strong product management expertise, including roadmap ownership, backlog prioritization, and requirements writing.
Experience with customer discovery, user research, and data-driven decision making.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, operations, and marketing.
Proficiency in defining and tracking product KPIs, performing basic analytics, and using product management tools.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
Proven track record of shipping and iterating digital products in an agile or similar development environment.
Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and strategic thinking abilities, with attention to detail and execution quality.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
Comfort working in a fully remote setting, with the ability to manage time, meet deadlines, and work across time zones.
Experience in a senior product role, ideally in technology or digital-focused organizations; background in leading complex initiatives is a plus.
